summary: Allocation initializer for a Huffman-tree context object a1. Calls the sub-allocator behind the vtable pointer at offset 0x4 to allocate an 80-byte context, stores it at offset 0x194, sets the context's first vtable entry to sub_51B7CD and zeroes vtable slots 14 through 17. Then calls the same sub-allocator for a flat table of slot_count * 256 bytes (slot_count read from offset 0x20, shifted left by 8), stores that pointer at offset 0x8C, and fills each 256-byte slot with 0xFF while slot_count is positive. Returns the table pointer when the fill loop is skipped and -1 after a completed fill loop.

operations.description: Indirect allocation call through the sub-allocator vtable at *(a1 + 4) with arguments (a1, 1, 80) to allocate an 80-byte Huffman-tree context.
Store the allocated context pointer at offset 0x194 (a1 + 404).
Set the context's vtable entry 0 to sub_51B7CD and zero the vtable slots 14, 15, 16 and 17.
Indirect allocation call through the same sub-allocator vtable at *(a1 + 4) with arguments (a1, 1, slot_count << 8) to allocate the flat table of slot_count * 256 bytes.
Store the allocated table pointer at offset 0x8C (a1 + 140).
Guard on the slot count at offset 0x20 being <= 0; when true the 0xFF fill loop is skipped.
Loop slot_count times over the flat table, memsetting each 256-byte slot to 0xFF.
Return result: the table pointer when the fill loop is skipped, otherwise -1 after the loop has run.
